gb_matrix.parity_note: Labelled parity 1 as in the spec (they enter only through the odd kappa). Computationally gb are commuting scalar coefficients: [b,a] is odd and kappa is odd, so the scalar gb must commute with everything.

inhomogeneous_deformation.convention: [X,Y]_gamma = [X,Y]_0 + kappa * gamma(X,Y), kappa written on the left
inhomogeneous_deformation.coefficient_format: coeff is a linear form {gb_label: rational}; gamma_XY^Z = sum gb * c
inhomogeneous_deformation.central_note: Z = 'K': component along the central element K = 1 (scalar part of gamma)
